name: otterbridge-shopee-mcp
description: Run your Shopee shop from your AI assistant — 32 tools for products, orders, shipping, returns and reports, plus every Shopee Open API v2 endpoint.
long_description:
Connects your own Shopee shop through the official Shopee Open Platform API v2, using your own developer app (Partner ID and Key from open.shopee.com).

Create listings in bulk from spreadsheet rows, change prices and stock by rule ("all T-shirts +RM2, ending in .90"), ship the day's orders and save the airway bills, handle returns, and get sales, fee and profit reports. Anything else in Shopee's API (vouchers, discounts, flash sales, ads, ...) is reachable through a bundled catalogue of all 454 v2 endpoints.

Nothing changes your shop without your OK: every write tool only returns a preview, and one tool, shopee_apply_plan, carries it out after you approve. Tokens stay on your computer.

Not affiliated with Shopee.

partner_id.title: Partner ID
partner_id.description: From your app at open.shopee.com/console/app. Use the Test Partner_id with the sandbox, the Live one with production.

partner_key.title: Partner Key
partner_key.description: The API Partner Key shown next to the Partner ID (click the eye icon). Kept in your system's secure storage.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: sandbox (test shops, Test credentials) or production (your real shop, Live credentials after Go-Live).

region.title: API region
region.description: global (default, all markets), cn (servers in mainland China) or br (Brazil).

redirect_uri.title: Redirect URL
redirect_uri.description: Where Shopee sends you after you authorize a shop. Leave the default so the server catches it on this computer.

shop_id.title: Default shop ID (optional)
shop_id.description: Only if you authorize several shops: the one used when a request doesn't name a shop. Otherwise set automatically.

read_only.title: Read-only
read_only.description: Look but never change: removes the tools that apply changes. Good for a reporting-only assistant.

toolsets.title: Tool groups (optional)
toolsets.description: Leave blank for everything. Or a comma list of core, catalog, insights — e.g. "core,insights" for orders and reports only.

export_dir.title: Save files to
export_dir.description: Where shipping labels and other files are saved.

tz_offset_hours.title: Time zone offset (hours)
tz_offset_hours.description: Used to group reports by day. 8 for Malaysia, Singapore, the Philippines and Taiwan; 7 for Thailand, Vietnam and Indonesia (WIB); -3 for Brazil.

tools.description: Show configuration, the pending authorization (if any), and every authorized shop (name, region, status, token expiry).

tools.name: shopee_set_default_shop
tools.description: Pick which authorized shop tools use when shop_id is omitted.

tools.name: shopee_apply_plan
tools.description: Execute a plan created by a write tool (shopee_products_update, shopee_products_delete, shopee_api_write, …).

tools.description: Call any Shopee Open API v2 endpoint that only reads data (GET, or POST endpoints named get_/search_/query_/check_).

tools.name: shopee_products_export
tools.description: Products as rows, one per SKU (each variation, or the product itself when it has no variations), with chosen fields.

tools.description: Permanently delete products by item_id or SKU.
